scripts.sync-data: cp -r src/data/* public/data/ && cp -r src/data/* data/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.check: node --check public/js/admin.js && node --check public/js/main.js && node --check public/js/store.js && node --check public/js/animations.js && node --check public/js/icons.js && npm run sync-data
scripts.dev: npm run sync-data && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
scripts.start: npm run sync-data && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
scripts.build: npm run sync-data && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build
